_comment: Rules for 'not_suited_for'. Each rule's 'when' maps an evidence/score field to inclusive {min,max} bounds; all conditions must hold. Matching rules contribute their 'text'. Fields available: latest_stress, max_stress, jump_count, rush_count, pct_time_calm, sessions_observed, rising_stress(0/1), energy, stress, approachability, confidence. Text is plain, guardrail-checked, no breed or diagnosis wording. Keep sentences short and factual.

rules.text: busy multi-pet homes until stress settles
homes expecting an immediately social dog
